capability: Run every claim through the same few tests
title: Every claim faces the same gates.

hook.picture: Close on the whale under an avalanche of paper cards, each stamped 'reasoning' with the same bright tab. More keep falling.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Every paper says it reasons. Which ones actually do?

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: a mountain of cards, all tabbed the same. Three more land on top, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½, each with the same stamp.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The title says it. Nobody tests it.

stakes.body: Weeks spent reading hype, and a team picks a tool because of a title.

solution_hint: Test every paper the same few ways.

metaphor.body: Five small gates stand on the line, each testing one thing (a reusable part, a real leap, a principle, a first, reuse by others). Every card runs the same five, and only those that pass reach a short shelf.

steps.picture: A card leaves the pile and runs the five gates. Three glow and two stay dark.
steps.words: Same five tests for every paper.
steps.sound: Five stepped marimba notes, one per gate

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): a card stamped 'reasoning' turns out to be a chatbot plus a calculator. The first gate shuts on it.
steps.sound: A low wooden block on the shut gate

steps.picture: Cards that pass slide to a short shelf and show two marks: a rule mark and a wave mark. A counter by the shelf ticks up slowly.
steps.words: Only what passes reaches the shelf.

steps.picture: The two marks on the shelf cards glow together.

real_case.claim: the-twenty-nesy keeps 20 filtered neurosymbolic reasoning papers plus an NLM harvest of 223 links. Manu's own JEV, scored on the same axes, "would not enter the Twenty today."

source.title: manutej/the-twenty-nesy; Notion JEV × JAX × The Twenty

honest_limit.picture: Still. A card that would shine on a sixth test nobody runs is turned away at the gates. It drifts off the line under a raw sienna flag.
honest_limit.words: A great idea we don't test drops.

not_this.body: A filter keeps our picks, not the truth.

ending_pattern.body: A shelf, not an avalanche: the falling cards now meet the gates first, and the whale reads one card from a short shelf.
ending_pattern.callback: The avalanche that buried the whale in bar 1 now lands on the gates, and the whale reads from a short shelf.

end_belief.body: Judge claims by tests, including your own.

A short shelf you can actually read.
Our own work did not make it.

score_self.reason: An honest self-score ("our own work did not make it") is a memorable CASE beat, and the avalanche-to-shelf callback is strong. Risk: the five axes are hard to show without labels, and "neurosymbolic" is a heavy word for learners.
